# LuggageHero

> LuggageHero is a global luggage storage service offering hourly and daily pricing with book-now-pay-later convenience at locations across major cities worldwide.

The platform connects travelers with secure luggage storage locations as an alternative to traditional lockers, featuring mobile apps for iPhone and Android, and a partner program for businesses to generate additional revenue. Service is available in multiple languages across cities in North America, Europe, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Luggage storage service
- Book now, pay later
- Hourly and daily pricing
- Mobile app (iPhone and Android)
- Baggage storage locations
- Travel services
- Partner revenue program
- Locker alternatives
- Major cities: Montreal, Miami, Paris, Bologna, Stockholm, Hamburg
- Airline baggage handling
- Lost luggage statistics
- Multi-language support
- Secure storage solutions
- Transportation hubs
- Tourist destinations
